author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Movies wouldn’t be where they are today without stunt coordinators, the professionals who can make incredible physical feats possible, and safe. However, how hard is it to throw a fake punch? Or fake fall? Or fake a sugar glass bottle? Two filmmaking amateurs, Colt & Tejas, take on the challenge to coordinate, act, and create a two minute action sequence alongside some Hollywood stuntmen to find out.

Rough Cut! is a trial-by-fire creative show. In every episode, hosts @ColtKirwan and @TejasHullur reverse-engineer the secrets of world-class storytellers, then put them to the test by creating their own version from scratch: their ‘rough cut’! Made possible by Adobe, the project acts as an unfiltered creator diary, documenting the raw stress, late nights, and technical pivots required to take an impossible idea from concept to execution.

Featuring:
Colt Kirwan
Tejas Hullur
Stunt Coordinators: Steven Koepfer & Paul Varacchi

Credits:
Directors: Colt Kirwan & Tejas Hullur
Editor: Shay Bu
title: How Hard is it to Become a Hollywood Stuntman, Really?
